title: US Consumer Prices Rise at Fastest Pace in Five Months
summary: Bloomberg Surveillance on the September 2026 CPI: headline 3.7, core 2.6 and slightly hot, groceries down while gasoline and fuel surge, and talk of a Fed hike creeps in.

assertions.quote: RECREATION USED CARS, TRUCKS, EDUCATION, MEDICAL CARE APPAREL. NOT A LOT OF DISINFLATION THERE.
FOOD AND HOME GROCERY PRICES WERE DOWN 1/10 OF A PERCENT WHICH IS INTERESTING BUT GASOLINE PRICES UP 9.1%
YOU CAN HAVE A LITTLE CHAT ABOUT THE PROSPECT OF A DECISION OF THE INTEREST RATE HIKE.

verdicts.note: A forecast of Fed behaviour; depends on Fed guidance and later data.
